title: Compile experimental reference data
action: Create a CSV file (experimental_data.csv) containing the experimental molecular constants from Table I: molecule, omega_e (cm⁻¹), k_e (10⁵ dyn/cm), r_e (10⁻⁸ cm), alpha_e_obs (cm⁻¹), omega_e_x_e_obs (cm⁻¹), D_i_obs (kcal/mol). The values are provided in the instruction.
description: Reference table of experimental molecular constants for the five alkali hydrides.
output_schema: Columns: molecule, omega_e, k_e, r_e, alpha_e_obs, omega_e_x_e_obs, D_i_obs

title: Compute Hellmann potential parameters and molecular constants
action: For each molecule (LiH, NaH, KH, RbH, CsH), use the experimental reference data to: (1) compute y = lambda * r_e from y^2/(y+1) = k_e * r_e^3 / e^2; (2) compute lambda = y / r_e; (3) compute alpha_e, omega_e x_e, and D_i from the Hellmann model formulas; (4) calculate percentage errors relative to the observed values. Write the results to hellmann_results.csv, with a final row giving the mean lambda across the series.
description: Hellmann model parameters and derived molecular constants with percentage errors for all five alkali hydrides, plus mean lambda.
output_schema: Columns: molecule (LiH,NaH,KH,RbH,CsH), y (dimensionless), lambda (10^8 cm⁻¹), alpha_calc (cm⁻¹), alpha_error_percent, omega_x_calc (cm⁻¹), omega_x_error_percent, Di_calc (kcal/mol), Di_error_percent. The last row has molecule='mean', lambda = mean lambda, other columns empty/0 except lambda.
